blueprint.summary: Scrapes Google Maps listings, ratings and websites for a service area. Works best as the first step of a local lead list, followed by a website scrape or enrichment.
use_when: You need local businesses of one type in a defined area
You will enrich the list afterwards
avoid_when: You need owner names or emails directly: the listings rarely have them

inputs.name: search_terms
inputs.note: Business type, for example roofing contractor

inputs.name: location
inputs.note: City or area; without it results cap at the per-area limit

setup.do: Start on the Free plan's monthly credit to size a run before paying.

steps.do: Run the actor with search terms plus an explicit location for the service area.
steps.check: Results cover the whole area, not one cluster
gotchas: A search term with no location stops at the per-area cap

steps.do: Split listings into those with a website and those without.
gotchas: Some listings lack a website or have thin details

steps.do: Plan a site scrape or enrichment step for the listings that need more detail.

thresholds.name: Results per search with no location
thresholds.why: Google Maps caps results per area unless a location is given

pitfalls.issue: Paid add-ons (contact enrichment, reviews, social profiles) are billed as separate events
pitfalls.fix: Leave add-ons off and enrich only the rows that need it later

pitfalls.issue: Thin listings stall the next step
pitfalls.fix: Route listings without a website to enrichment instead of a site scrape

quality_bar: Every listing has a category and location
Listings without a website are marked

free_alternatives: The Free plan's monthly credit covers a small run

limits.note: Memory in GB times run hours, billed to the second

verify_live: Price per thousand places and per add-on
